commerce_outbox.name: schema_version
commerce_outbox.mapping: CommerceEvent.schemaVersion; wire schema version, not aggregate version

fields.name: id
fields.mapping: external inv_stock_balance.id; never copied into commerce

fields.name: tenant_no
fields.mapping: trusted bridge maps tenant to platform inventory owner_id; inventory has no tenant_no

fields.name: deleted
fields.mapping: omitted: inventory has no soft-delete field; host lifecycle owns archival

fields.name: hardware_sku_no
fields.mapping: bridge resolves HardwareInventoryPort skuNo to inv_item.item_id under platform owner_id

fields.name: warehouse_no
fields.mapping: bridge selects configured inv_location.location_id under same owner_id

fields.name: on_hand_qty
fields.mapping: external inv_stock_balance.on_hand (INT; bridge validates quantity bounds)
